MASTER SERVICES AGREEMENT

This Master Services Agreement (the "Agreement") is entered into as of April 15, 2026 (the "Effective Date") between Northwind Analytics Ltd., a company registered in England ("Client") and Harbor Pixel Studio LLC, a Delaware limited liability company ("Contractor").

1. Services
1.1 The Contractor shall provide the design and development services described in each Statement of Work.
1.2 The Contractor shall deliver monthly progress reports to the Client no later than the fifth business day of each month.

2. Term and Renewal
2.1 This Agreement shall commence on the Effective Date and continue for a period of twelve (12) months.
2.2 This Agreement may be renewed for a further term by written agreement of both parties.

3. Fees and Payment
3.1 The Client shall pay the Contractor a monthly fee of USD 14,000.
3.2 The Client shall pay each invoice within thirty (30) days of receipt of the invoice.
3.3 Overdue amounts shall accrue interest at 1% per month until paid.

4. Confidentiality
Each party shall keep the other party's Confidential Information strictly confidential and shall not disclose it to any third party. These obligations survive for five (5) years after termination.

5. Intellectual Property
Upon full payment, the Contractor assigns to the Client all right, title and interest in the deliverables created under this Agreement.

6. Limitation of Liability
Each party's aggregate liability under this Agreement shall not exceed the fees paid in the twelve (12) months preceding the claim.

7. Indemnification
Each party shall indemnify the other party against third-party claims caused by its breach of this Agreement.

8. Termination
8.1 Either party may terminate this Agreement for convenience upon thirty (30) days' written notice.
8.2 Either party may terminate this Agreement for material breach that is not cured within thirty (30) days.

9. Data Protection
The Contractor shall process customer personal data only on the Client's documented instructions and in accordance with the GDPR.

10. Governing Law
This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of England and Wales, and the courts of London shall have exclusive jurisdiction.

11. Insurance
The Contractor shall maintain professional indemnity insurance of at least USD 1,000,000 during the term.
